articleTitle: 10 Crime Movies That Are Perfectly Written
articleDescription: It takes some skill to write any good crime movie. It’s a sentiment you can probably agree with if you’ve seen one of the worst crime movies of all time , like Gotti (2018), Gigli (2003), or The Snowman (2017). Those films show there are so many ways a screenplay for a crime movie can go wrong, and though those films have flaws beyond the writing, they were all pretty much doomed from the start, owing to the… you know… writing.

articleTitle: 24 Years Later, the Best Sci-Fi Western of All Time Is Taking Over the World
articleDescription: It isn't uncommon for popular television shows to inspire follow-up feature films, as was recently seen with Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man . Every generation has a favorite series that received a theatrical sequel; both Sex and the City and Entourage were revived on the big screen. However, around two decades ago, 20th Century Studios made the decision to produce a theatrical feature film follow-up to a show that barely survived its first season. Far from finding the same success as Peaky Blinders , the show was unceremoniously cancelled after a 14-episode first season . Shortly after its initial run, the show in question became a word-of-mouth hit on home video. Reruns proved that it had struck a chord with its target audience, and a decision was made to give them what they wanted.

articleTitle: Netflix Is About to Lose the Greatest Spy Thriller Series of All Time
articleDescription: April is going to be a frustrating month for action movie fans with a Netflix subscription. The streaming giant has a plethora of great action flicks currently available on its roster in the United States, but this month is going to see an enormous exodus from the lineup, thanks to the removal of one of the genre's most iconic franchises . In one fell swoop, just a few days from now, Netflix is losing an entire 26-entry film series , leaving the streamer without fiction's most iconic spy.

articleTitle: 10 Classic Movies That Are Still Masterpieces Today
articleDescription: Time is the ultimate critic. Trends fade, techniques age, and entire genres fall out of favor, yet some films endure, not just as relics, but as living works of art . These are the movies that still feel urgent and alive many decades after release. Whether through innovation, emotional depth, or sheer storytelling precision, they continue to resonate across generations.
